autism_enjoyer_08: On Day 4 Bastian Enjoyer took a post at R-F23 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He laughs at exactly the wrong moments, and the men liked him for it.

A shell burst over R-F23 and threw Bastian Enjoyer into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian Enjoyer raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F23. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 has been won. Bastian Enjoyer listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Bastian Enjoyer waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

There was never a bed for Bastian Enjoyer, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F23 on his own feet. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Bastian Enjoyer waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Bastian Enjoyer has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Bastian Enjoyer dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Anselm Alexj coming out. It was over in seconds. (@alexj.558) The flare went up just as Bastian Enjoyer reached the Concord parapet. Bastian Enjoyer jumped down first. Karel Adauto was the man waiting there, and Karel Adauto fell. (@santiago.g.adauto) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F23 changed before the cheering ended. Bastian Enjoyer shouldered another load. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian Enjoyer lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian Enjoyer is number 317 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Bastian Enjoyer did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Bastian Enjoyer and Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian Enjoyer drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below Sorrow Copse the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian Enjoyer was hit through the stomach at R-F23. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Bastian Enjoyer was carried in at last. Bastian Enjoyer opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F23 they cheered when the news came up the line. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian Enjoyer returned to R-F23 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian Enjoyer threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Marek Punchworth was down and screaming for a medic. (@lord_punchworth) The Concord sentry, Felix Someonenamed, shouted once. Bastian Enjoyer silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@someonenamedmiguel) Bastian Enjoyer came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A letter for Bastian Enjoyer came with a pressed flower inside. Bastian Enjoyer showed the flower to nobody.

A parcel came for Bastian Enjoyer that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. Bastian Enjoyer read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
cal.cbr: Leopold Cbr arrived at Q-F16 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Leopold Cbr held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. Victory at Grey Mill. Leopold Cbr let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Leopold Cbr kept Karel "Lucky" Keegan awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Leopold could have walked there blind.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Leopold Cbr as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Leopold Cbr and Bram Amanatidis spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Leopold Cbr helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Leopold Cbr in the open at Q-F16. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril Bro of the Concord (@band_bro.1). Leopold Cbr looked over the parapet at Q-F16 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Cyril Bro of the Concord (@band_bro.1).
The House of Cbr sent Teodor "Button" Cbr after Leopold Cbr. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Teodor "Button" Cbr fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
claymcc18: On the way to N-F14, Clement "Hollow" Claymcc tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Clement "Hollow" Claymcc took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at N-F14, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Roland Dav of the Concord (@dav.cl_). Clement "Hollow" Claymcc was killed outright at N-F14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Roland Dav of the Concord (@dav.cl_).
Another member of the House of Claymcc reached the line: Severin Claymcc. He asked where Clement "Hollow" Claymcc had slept, then chose a different corner.
A round came through the loophole Severin Claymcc was watching at N-F14 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Gideon Senpai of the Concord (@emelryk_senpai).
Severin Claymcc spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Severin Claymcc healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
damiancarrillo2003: Day 9. The corporal put Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril waited for that to change. When it did, Zeno Illegalxeno was badly wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Rumour reached Q-S9 that the war would be over by spring. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril has heard it before. So has everyone.
Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno, was grazed.
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead snores. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril does not. Whistle now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
deionmurillo: Bastian Deionmurillo arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

The Hegemony sentry, Ulrich Yoye, shouted once. Bastian Deionmurillo silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@yoye501) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Bastian Deionmurillo hit Zeno Illegalxeno with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@illegalxeno9) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Bastian Deionmurillo was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Bastian Deionmurillo looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Bastian Deionmurillo is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deionmurillo. Bastian Deionmurillo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-S8 with the rations. Bastian Deionmurillo ate while listening to the revised orders.
Bastian Deionmurillo was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Bastian Deionmurillo found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Bastian Deionmurillo crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at Q-S8 holds again.
Bastian Deionmurillo saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Casimir Chickenman, grazed.

Bastian Deionmurillo threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Leopold "Owl" Viti was down and screaming for a medic. (@viti_w02) Bastian Deionmurillo came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
Bastian Deionmurillo returned to Q-S8 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
democracy_man2144: Day 9. The corporal put Dorian Man beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Dorian Man helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Dorian Man and Gideon "Crow" Colm have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out. The clerk counted the names twice. Dorian Man is number 861 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-C3 changed before the cheering ended. Dorian Man shouldered another load.
Dorian Man and Felix "Tin" Jtall split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Dorian Man spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Viktor You taught Dorian Man three words in the language of home. Dorian uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Dorian Man. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
The sergeant at S-C3 called out a range and a spot. Dorian Man was the only one who hit it. Oskar "Parson" Egilhermanss was badly wounded.
Dorian Man fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar was badly wounded. Dorian Man ate breakfast without a word.
dortch.andrew: Dorian Andrew arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Dorian Andrew polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Dorian Andrew stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Dorian Andrew. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

Dorian Andrew was hit through the stomach at U-F7. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10). A single shot at U-F7. Dorian Andrew sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10).
A letter came with Viktor Andrew: "I am Dorian Andrew's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Viktor Andrew's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant.
Little Sergeant the rat now waits for Viktor Andrew at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Little Sergeant ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Viktor Andrew followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Little Sergeant his life.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Viktor Andrew received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
dratlaix: Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix tried to describe the smell of Marrow Fen and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. The machine gunners took Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix in on a busy morning in R-S2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix is number 564. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix (Concord) and Henrik Zxburg (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Hanging Bridge. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at R-S2. Before dawn Ivo "Rabbit" Beck walked into it, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier.

The stores supplied Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Konrad Embersky was grazed. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier.
Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix finished the shelter. The crew tested every movement of the gun and discovered that the roof needed moving back a hand's width.

The altered shelter passed inspection. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix found the crew had added a tiny sign: 'No lodgers'. Someone had already left a blanket inside. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.
guapoo007_: Dorian "Mole" Guapoo arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo moved a lucky button to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F2 changed before the cheering ended. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo shouldered another load.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F2. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Leopold "Saint" Hop of the Concord (@its.hop_). A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Anselm Perry saved the last of the sugar for Dorian "Mole" Guapoo's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Mole's birthday. It was a good day anyway. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo is number 276. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A loose thread in Dorian "Mole" Guapoo's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
A bullet hit Dorian "Mole" Guapoo's belt buckle at S-F2 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Norbert Rottenr of the Concord (@rottenr0be).
Three days with a bandage, and Dorian "Mole" Guapoo is back at S-F2. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Dorian "Mole" Guapoo wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Dorian "Mole" Guapoo was carrying water up to S-F2 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo did not. Shot by Teodor Rottenr of the Concord (@rottenr0be).
Dorian "Mole" Guapoo spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
jarosztyler: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Teodor Crabesquash kept watch so that Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler could sleep. Then Saint kept watch so that Teodor could. Neither slept. A letter for Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler came with a photograph. Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler looked at it for a long time and said nothing.

Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler and Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. The letter for Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler ended with 'come home soon'. Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler read the last line more than the rest.
jeremythomas52: Norbert Jeremythomas, a blacksmith from Kesselby, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in U-F15. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Norbert Jeremythomas was hit through the chest at U-F15. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Norbert Jeremythomas fell at U-F15 and never moved again. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel).

The papers say Matthias Jeremythomas. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Norbert Jeremythomas's eyes. Nobody in U-F15 argues. Grey Mill is lost. Matthias Jeremythomas heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Matthias Jeremythomas of the Concord and Oskar Rykerfallion of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Saint-Ash crossroads. It is getting crowded.
A bullet grazed Matthias Jeremythomas's ribs at U-F15. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829).

Machine-gun fire swept U-F15. Matthias Jeremythomas took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel). The bearers reached Matthias Jeremythomas at U-F15 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel).
The papers connected Emil Jeremythomas to Matthias Jeremythomas. The men took longer to learn Emil Jeremythomas's own habits, but they made the effort.
Emil Jeremythomas hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Emil Jeremythomas (Concord) and Konrad "Mud" Pawington (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Chalk Pits on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Someone asked Emil Jeremythomas to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
lucas.b.garbo: Cyril "Bones" Garbo walked into S-C9 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Cyril "Bones" Garbo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet hit Cyril "Bones" Garbo's belt buckle at S-C9 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony (@sonofadeadmeme). Cyril "Bones" Garbo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 651. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Cyril "Bones" Garbo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The wound on Cyril "Bones" Garbo's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Cyril "Bones" Garbo found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Cyril "Bones" Garbo took the long way round the Ossuary Wood because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
Cyril "Bones" Garbo's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.

Shell splinters caught Cyril "Bones" Garbo in the chest and belly at S-C9. The medic worked with both hands and shouted for a bed. Cyril "Bones" Garbo died at S-C9 under a direct hit. A medic who saw it says it was over in a moment.
Jonas "Lucky" Garbo came to the front because his uncle Cyril "Bones" Garbo never came home. He carries a photograph gone soft at the edges.

Jonas "Lucky" Garbo was hit in the forearm at S-C9. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony (@sonofadeadmeme).
magnusmadsen37: At the depot, Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen had practised answering to his name. At R-F18, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. Verdel Ridge is lost. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen's hands still remember being a tailor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.

A patient at the aid post asked Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Ulrich Asher and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at Hill 304, Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen was promoted to Lance Corporal.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen asks about each detail while changing the dressing.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen across the shin at R-F18. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr of the Concord (@kelvincornbread).

Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Before evacuation, the patient asked Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen to tear the drawing from the paper lining the wall. He managed it without losing the stove. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen is number 192. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
A note arrived from the hospital: the kitchen drawing survived the journey. The patient intends to show the builder exactly where the extra chair should go.

A bullet hit Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen's belt buckle at R-F18 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord (@levitobambito).
Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Rafael Caden (Concord) watched Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Grey Mill, and held fire until both were gone.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
manmc.maann: At the depot, Florian Maann had practised answering to his name. At S-S5, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Florian Maann invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Maann. Florian Maann read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian Maann went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Albin Chloe was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@chloe.g.t) Florian Maann jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Felix "Parson" Brendanm. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@brendanm_4) The Hegemony raiders came over at S-S5 in the middle of the night. Florian Maann met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Yann Somosmagios of the Hegemony (@somosmagios.bo).
Bastian "Mud" Maann had heard about Florian Maann's courage. At S-S5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Someone asked Bastian "Mud" Maann to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian "Mud" Maann answered to number 502. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Bastian "Mud" Maann read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet hit Bastian "Mud" Maann's belt buckle at S-S5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Gustav Heyyybigmike of the Hegemony (@heyyybigmike).

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Bastian "Mud" Maann is whole again, or near enough for the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Mud" Maann. Bastian "Mud" Maann read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bastian "Mud" Maann went out with the wiring party at S-S5. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Bastian "Mud" Maann reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Bastian "Mud" Maann across the shin at S-S5. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Quentin Vicious of the Hegemony (@darth._.vicious).
Bastian "Mud" Maann walked back up the communication trench to S-S5, slower than before, but on his own feet.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Clockmaker. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Clockmaker hit all three. Bastian "Mud" Maann watched where the shots came from.
marquis_de_lafayette1757_1834: Nobody saw Matthias Lafayette arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F12, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it.
One of the first hundred, Matthias Lafayette was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Matthias Lafayette shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Matthias Lafayette folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Matthias Lafayette read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Matthias Lafayette put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.

Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home reached Matthias Lafayette before dusk. Matthias Lafayette read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Matthias Lafayette stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Matthias Lafayette won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in S-F12. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Rematch. Matthias Lafayette lost everything he won, plus a dented harmonica. The whole dugout watched. A letter from home reached Matthias Lafayette before dusk. Matthias Lafayette read it twice and slept a little easier.
Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

Matthias Lafayette was hit through the chest at S-F12. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Matthias Lafayette stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F12. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).

Nils Lafayette came to the front because his cousin Matthias Lafayette never came home. He carries a dented harmonica. Nils Lafayette's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Nils Lafayette heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. Orders came through: Nils Lafayette is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a dented harmonica.

Nils Lafayette gave Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard the last match in the trench. Brick used it to light a candle so that Nils could finish a letter. A letter from home reached Nils Lafayette before dusk. Nils Lafayette read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-F12, Nils Lafayette listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Nils Lafayette shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Severin Heheheha, was grazed.
Ulrich Axelat lent Nils Lafayette a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Nils Lafayette heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.

A sniper's bullet hit Nils Lafayette at S-F12. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils Lafayette fell at S-F12 and never moved again. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti).
Henrik "Bones" Lafayette had heard about Nils Lafayette's courage. At S-F12, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F12 they left Henrik "Bones" Lafayette behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Casimir Acquillae of the Hegemony (@vis.acquillae).
The House of Lafayette sent another. Teodor Lafayette, uncle of Henrik "Bones" Lafayette, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
At S-F12 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Teodor Lafayette won the bet. Lucien Darian was grazed.
mikesamham: Day 15. The corporal put Bastian Mikesamham beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
A note came over the wire at the Chalk Pits, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Bastian Mikesamham.' Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo sang louder.
Rafael Vader of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Calvary Farm. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Bastian Mikesamham's name scratched on the lid.
nicholasberthelotte: The draft reached R-R15 on Day 9. Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Orders came through: Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert is a stretcher bearer now. He handed in his old kit and kept only his mother's thimble.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert and Clement "Spark" Jcksn carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert gave Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde the last match in the trench. Hollow used it to light a candle so that Spark could finish a letter.
projectpuffypenguin: Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy came up on Day 3 carrying news from Brennmoor. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
The trench wall shook against Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.

Yann Vee wrote a letter for Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's mother, because Saint could not find the words. Saint signed it. A letter from home reached Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy before dusk. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F4 and grazed Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4).
The medics cleaned Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F4.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's ear at S-F4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).

Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy (Concord) and Florian Fitness (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Sorrow Copse. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. The clerk counted the names twice. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy is number 229 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Shell splinters hit Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy in the back and legs at S-F4. The bearers carried him face down on the stretcher.
No bed for Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-F4, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
r.raphoto: They issued Lucien Raphoto a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a frozen apple in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Lucien Raphoto, volunteer number 60, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Lucien Raphoto wrote a list of things to buy on leave. It began with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Lucien Raphoto polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Otto Valiantlyval pulled Lucien Raphoto out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither of them has mentioned it since. Both of them remember. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Lucien Raphoto could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Lucien Raphoto's hands still remember being a medical student's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Lucien Raphoto began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Nobody else in S-F13 wanted the stripes. Lucien Raphoto said yes. Lance Corporal. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Lucien Raphoto watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The reply to Lucien Raphoto's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Lucien Raphoto asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Lucien Raphoto shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Otto Carlingiti, was badly wounded.
Lucien Raphoto received a letter announcing checkmate. The dugout insists the position was copied incorrectly. He has written back asking for another game.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F13. Lucien Raphoto was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Walter Mat of the Hegemony (@civo_mat).

The papers connected Otto Raphoto to Lucien Raphoto. The men took longer to learn Otto Raphoto's own habits, but they made the effort. The first hundred were recognised, and Otto Raphoto was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.

Otto Raphoto and Ivo Camper found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Ivo. After the loss of Grey Mill, Otto Raphoto helped stack spare sandbags at S-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet hit Otto Raphoto in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F13. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_). Otto Raphoto was hit at S-F13 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_).
Zeno Raphoto came to the front because his uncle Otto Raphoto never came home. He carries a frozen apple.

Zeno Raphoto had just lit a cigarette at S-F13 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_).

A sniper's bullet hit Zeno Raphoto at S-F13. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Zeno Raphoto fell at S-F13 and never moved again. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_).
A letter came with Jonas Raphoto: "I am Zeno Raphoto's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Jonas Raphoto was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Jonas Raphoto had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Quentin "Crow" Alpharius, badly wounded.
Jonas Raphoto reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F13 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939).
tylerlockadoodle: Karel Tylerlockado told the sergeant he was a blacksmith. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Tylerlockado kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Karel Tylerlockado drew a map of Lucien Paulohwa's hometown from Lucien's stories. Lucien says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Karel Tylerlockado got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 979. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel Tylerlockado read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Karel Tylerlockado's bunk. He has named it Margarethe.
Margarethe the rat now waits for Karel Tylerlockado at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Karel Tylerlockado tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
A bullet clipped Karel Tylerlockado's helmet at S-R16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Valentin Marius of the Hegemony (@marius12214).
Karel Tylerlockado stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
The medics called Karel Tylerlockado 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Karel Tylerlockado is back on the line.
wtz.lft: Jakub Lft walked into S-R12 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Jakub Lft helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Jakub Lft borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Jakub Lft during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Someone in S-R12 asked Jakub Lft about Coldwater. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Promoted to Lance Corporal, Jakub Lft had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier.
Jakub Lft tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

Jakub Lft took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-R12, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Yann Zgz of the Concord (@raivantm.zgz).
Jakub Lft lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
For days Jakub Lft was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
